description: This file defines a configuration utility for a React frontend application, providing runtime configuration derived from environment variables. It includes functions to normalize URLs and to assemble configuration parameters such as API URL, frontend URL, WebSocket URL, environment, and feature flags.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by removing trailing slashes for consistent URL joining.

methods.name: getAppConfig()
methods.description: Returns runtime configuration based on environment variables such as API base URL, frontend URL, WebSocket URL, environment, and feature flags.
